caption_L1: This is a bar plot named Number of prescription items of varenicline (Champix) to quit smoking in England from 2006/07 to 2019/20 (in 1,000). Year is measured with a categorical scale from 2006/07 to 2019/20 on the x-axis. The y-axis shows Number of prescriptions using a linear scale of range 0 to 1,000.
caption_L2L3: The amount of varenicline being used in England has decreased since 2010/11. In 2006/7 in England, the least amount of varenicline was being used to quit smoking (in 1,000). 2019/10 has had the least amount of varenicline used in England since 2019/20 (in 1,000). There was a high increase of varenicline being used in England between 2006/7 and 2007/08.
